sources.title: National Park Service — SS Jeremiah O’Brien
sources.supports: 441 ft 6 in overall length and 56 ft beam. Published tonnage lacks a precise loading/unit pairing; game displacement is an explicit estimate.

sources.title: Project Liberty Ship — ship history
sources.supports: Five-hold cargo/troop role, two boilers and single reciprocating drive. Cargo defensive fit: aft 5-inch, forward 3-inch, eight 20 mm; limited troop conversion adds two aft 3-inch guns. This representative preset is not a named Brown reconstruction.

sources.title: NPS / Library of Congress — Patrick Henry, 1941, Photo 4
sources.supports: Qualitative hull, three mast and deckhouse silhouette. Early unarmed, light-load photograph; does not verify the late-war armament or loaded waterline.
sources.usage: Reference only. Library of Congress image credited by NPS; not a texture or geometric build input.

sources.title: American Merchant Marine at War — Liberty ships
sources.supports: 11-knot service speed and carried deck equipment. The eight independently authored vehicle shapes are a representative deck load, not a sourced manifest.

independence: Only original recipe, blueprint and component catalog feed the production model. No GameModels3D or other game assets used.
